name: event
description: Short messages mentioning one event (hand-written), including relative dates. Reference date: Wednesday 2026-09-23.
instructions: Today is Wednesday, September 23, 2026. Extract the single event mentioned in the message. date is YYYY-MM-DD; relative weekdays ('Friday', 'this Friday', 'next Friday') mean the first such weekday after today. startTime is 24-hour HH:MM. durationMinutes is the length in minutes if the message states an end time or duration, otherwise omit it.
